description: This PHP script functions as the login page controller for the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles configuration checking, user authentication, session management, OAuth login flows, rendering the login page, and post-login redirection logic.

classes.name: tl
classes.description: Namespace presumed to contain constants like OK used for OAuth token status checks.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Parses and initializes the arguments from GET/POST parameters, determining the intended action such as login, OAuth callback, or login form display.

methods.name: validateOauth
methods.description: Validates that the OAuth provider name provided is in the configured whitelist.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes graphical UI configuration, including security notes, OAuth buttons, background images, and session-based notices.

methods.name: doBlockingChecks
methods.description: Checks schema version and compatibility; blocks login if schema is outdated or incompatible.

methods.name: renderLoginScreen
methods.description: Renders the login page using Smarty templates, passing GUI configuration and notices.

methods.name: authorizePostProcessing
methods.description: Handles post-authentication actions such as redirecting on success or showing error messages.

methods.name: processAjaxCheck
methods.description: Returns JSON indicating whether the session is valid, with localized UI labels.

methods.name: cleanInput
methods.description: Sanitizes input strings by removing scripts, HTML tags, styles, and comments.
